parts: How are shinyapp.io account hours accumulated?  Very surprised with the reported accumulated hours on my starter account, as my app times out quickly during non usage.  Any settings advice for how to slow down the accumulation?  Also, what can I expect for performance boost when upgrading account?   Thanks

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: account hours, performance boost
parts:
You should see a correlation between connections and hours. If you are not, as a paying customer, I would suggest opening a support ticket so we can properly track an investigation.

Performance boost will allow you to set a larger instance size for your application(s) that allow for more CPU and memory shares, as well as more workers. The workers come into play when you have larger numbers of users of your applications.
